entities.summary: Fumiko Ueda, known by her pen name Fumiko Enchi , was a Japanese writer and playwright known for her explorations into the ideas of sexuality, gender, human identity, and spirituality. She is considered one of the most prominent women writers of Shōwa period Japan.
